note: A Highlands chest and loot, first drafts. Sizes in px at 640x360. item_* are 16x16 bag icons, drop_* lie on the ground (put the foot on the spot). See README.md.

chest.note: Frame 0 is the closed chest. Play 0 to 4 when it is opened: unlatched, lifting, thrown open, settled open with its loot showing.

chest_empty.note: Open and emptied: what an opened chest stays as.

item_blank_rune.note: A passive blank rune stone: smooth, with an empty socket.

item_part_bundle.note: A weapon part, wrapped: one picture for any part lying on the ground.

item_accessory_pouch.note: An accessory, in its pouch: one picture for any accessory lying on the ground.

item_horn_body.note: The Rusted Warhorn's body (elite Scrap Brute).

item_horn_bell.note: The Rusted Warhorn's bell (elite Cliff Hound).

item_horn_mouthpiece.note: The Rusted Warhorn's mouthpiece (elite Pebble Slinger).

item_cellar_key.note: The Watchpost cellar key (an extra, not asked for yet).

drop_coins.note: Frame 1 has a small glint: show it for a moment every second or two.
